Description: Verify the SEC-ONODE-32-2 replay is CLOSED: 60 GET /passes/1 from one source IP with X-API-Key 'A<dynamic_id>' exhaust the per-IP bucket, and a 61st request from the SAME IP with a DIFFERENT X-API-Key 'B<dynamic_id>' is 429 (rotating the header no longer resets the bucket — the client key is the source IP only)
PreRequisites: Execute SQL: INSERT INTO passes (id, vehicle, months, plate, price, txn_id, status) VALUES (<dynamic_id>, 'car', 1, 'SEEDPLATE', 1000, 'txn-seed-ONODE35', 'ACTIVE')
Steps: Call GET /passes/<dynamic_id> 60 times from the same source IP, each with header {'X-API-Key': 'A<dynamic_id>'} (per-IP bucket now exhausted) | Call GET /passes/<dynamic_id> from the SAME source IP with header {'X-API-Key': 'B<dynamic_id>'} (rotated header — must NOT create a new bucket)
ExpectedResult: HTTP 200 OK. JSON contains {'id': <dynamic_id>, 'vehicle': 'car', 'months': 1, 'plate': 'SEEDPLATE', 'currency': 'THB', 'status': 'ACTIVE'} | HTTP 429 Too Many Requests. JSON contains {'detail': 'too many requests'}
Post-Assertions: Execute SQL: SELECT count(*) FROM passes WHERE id = <dynamic_id> -> Expected: 1
Teardown: Execute SQL: DELETE FROM passes WHERE id = <dynamic_id>;
